summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K disclosing privately negotiated exchange agreements dated September 23, 2026 with Streeterville Capital, LLC, holder of its $10.81 million secured 2025 Note issued November 12, 2025. Jaguar issued 547,898 common shares in exchange for a $5,049,909.26 reduction of the note balance, implying roughly $9.22 per share, under Section 3(a)(9). Outstanding shares are approximately 1,281,867. No board recommendation or advisor named. The transaction retires debt without cash, but heavily dilutes holders and leaves a residual secured obligation Streeterville may convert or demand. Watch for further exchanges and dilution.
